system_prompt_style.note: Prompts vary per model and project context files (AGENTS.md) are discovered and injected.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: `grep` — regex over files, globs, and internal URLs.
env_context_strategy.note: Also injects discovered AGENTS.md project context; primary mode is tool-driven exploration.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Bitmap-frame context compression package and SQuAD eval suite
context_compaction.note: `checkpoint` — mark conversation state for a later collapse-and-report; `rewind` — prune exploratory context; compaction referenced throughout docs.

observation_format.evidence_quote: `computer` — persistent JS against the host desktop: windows, screenshots, native input, AX tree, clipboard.
observation_format.note: AX tree also available via computer tool; raw text is the default for read/grep/bash.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Agent runtime with tool calling and state management
tool_call_format.note: Provider APIs (anthropic-messages, openai-completions/responses) imply native tool-call API.

tool_count.evidence_quote: 31 tools live in the same namespace as `read` and `bash`.
tool_count.note: Several are setting-gated off by default (github, security_scan, generate_image, tts, checkpoint, rewind, memory tools), so the default active set is smaller; 31 is the shipped built-in count.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `edit` — hashline patches with content-hash anchors and stale-anchor recovery.
edit_primitive.note: `write` — create or overwrite a file; `ast_edit` — structural rewrites previewed before apply, via ast-grep. Hashline is anchor-based content matching, closest to search_replace.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: rules, skills, and MCP servers from `.claude`, `.cursor`, `.windsurf`
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schemas authored in TypeScript modules (extension is a TypeScript module, same tool API); MCP servers contribute schemas.

protocol_standardization.note: other = ACP; MCP servers discovered from existing configs; topics list includes mcp.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: `orchestrate` — run substantial independent work through parallel subagents and verify each phase.
loop_primitives.note: Default is a ReAct tool loop; `plan` role/plan mode and `workflowz` deterministic multi-subagent workflow are config/keyword reachable; session emits typed events.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `todo` — ordered mutations over the session todo list with phase tracking.
planning_granularity.note: Also a `plan` model role and plan mode.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: `task` — fan out subagents in parallel, optionally workspace-isolated.
multi_agent_topology.note: One primary agent by default; orchestrator_workers reachable through the shipped `task` tool and /review.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: task fans out into isolated worktrees, each worker runs its own tool surface

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Destructive tools pause for a permission prompt you can answer once and forget.
human_in_loop.note: `tools.approvalMode`, per-tool approval policies, and `autoApprove` make gating configurable; `ask` tool routes ambiguity to the human.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Agent runtime with tool calling and state management
short_term_state.note: Session todo list with phase tracking plus session state beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: It writes facts mid-run with retain, captures reusable lessons with learn, pulls them back with recall
long_term_memory.note: Memory tools are setting-gated off by default (per memory.backend); backends local/Hindsight/Mnemopi (Local SQLite memory engine). Skills via manage_skill and discovered skill dirs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: model names (`--model`, `--smol`, `--slow`, `--plan`) resolve against the bundled model catalog and `--resume` against your on-disk sessions.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Pair a reviewer model to the 'advisor' role and it reads every turn the main agent takes
self_verification.note: Advisor requires advisor.enabled: true (off by default); `lsp` gives diagnostics on writes; /review spawns reviewer subagents.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Per-role or per-model chains under `retry.fallbackChains`. When the primary throws 429s or hits a quota wall, the next entry takes the rest of the turn
retry_policy.note: Only provider-level retry/fallback is documented; no task-level re-attempt policy found in the evidence.

rollback.evidence_quote: Task isolation backend resolver: APFS clones, btrfs/zfs reflinks, overlayfs, projfs, rcopy
rollback.note: Subagent worktree isolation; ast_edit changes are staged and applied atomically (all or nothing).

termination_condition.evidence_quote: After the final prompt settles, print mode preserves late advisor notes without starting hidden primary turns, then waits up to ten minutes for final reviews
termination_condition.note: Turn ends when the agent yields; context window limits force compaction. No explicit max-step or cost cap found in the supplied evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Ten roles route work by intent. `default` for normal turns. `smol` for cheap subagent fan-out.
cost_controls.note: `/fresh` — reset the provider stream state (stale prompt cache) implies prompt caching; no explicit token budget cap in the evidence.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Blocking work on libuv thread pool · cancellation · timeout · profiling
timeouts.note: A `timeout` builtin also ships; no run-level timeout except the advisor drain deadlines.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: `bash` — workspace shell with 46 in-process coreutils, optional PTY, and background-job dispatch.
execution_isolation.note: Runs in-process/on the host by default; subagent tasks can be workspace-isolated via pi-iso, and a Dockerfile ships.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: `read` — files, dirs, archives, SQLite, PDFs, notebooks, URLs, remote `ssh://` paths, and internal `://` schemes through one path.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the host boundary; tools are workspace-oriented but reach the whole filesystem and remote paths.

network_policy.evidence_quote: web_search chains twenty-three ranked providers and hands whatever URLs it finds straight to read.
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism described in the evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: they honor the session's normal approval mode and per-tool policies
permission_model.note: `tools.approvalMode`, per-tool approval policies and `autoApprove`; ACP writes gated by session/request_permission.

tracing.evidence_quote: Local observability dashboard for AI usage statistics
tracing.note: Sessions persisted on disk and resumable; `/debug` opens tools for debugging, reporting, and profiling. No OpenTelemetry exporter in evidence.

replayability.note: Sessions can be exported, forked and resumed; no deterministic replay claim.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Unified benchmark runners, Harbor run storage, REST/SSE API, live dashboard

guardrails.evidence_quote: A regex match aborts the stream mid-token, injects the rule as a system reminder, and retries from the same point.
guardrails.note: Stream rules + approval policies gate actions; tool arguments/results pass through the session secret obfuscator (output filtering).

target_domain.evidence_quote: A coding agent with the IDE wired in.
target_domain.note: browser + web_search (web), computer/desktop tool (gui_computer_use), MCP servers (general_tool_use).

open_source.evidence_quote: OMP is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Multi-provider LLM client with streaming and model/provider integration
